lease.intro: Every parcel-specific contractual field below is intentionally BLANK (null) in this public workspace to preserve owner privacy. Populate each row in the private offline lease abstract before initiating renewal discussions or listing the property.

rows.clause: Exact Lease Commencement & Primary Expiration Date
rows.why_critical: Fixes exact remaining lease term (WALT) inside the 2030–2035 window; 12 months difference shifts institutional lender eligibility and buyer cap rates.
rows.verification_step: Read original lease + all recorded memoranda/amendments + latest signed tenant estoppel.

rows.clause: Renewal Options Count, Term Length & Exact Exercise Notice Window
rows.why_critical: Missing an option notice deadline (e.g., 180–365 days prior to expiry) or misunderstanding unilateral tenant options destroys negotiating leverage.
rows.verification_step: Extract earliest/latest notice dates, delivery method (certified mail/overnight), and notice addresses.

rows.clause: Tenant Entity & Lease Guarantor (JACK Corporate vs. Franchisee LLC)
rows.why_critical: 93% of JACK units (1,966 of 2,115 in Q3 FY26) are franchised, often subleased from JACK or leased directly by franchisee SPEs. Credit pricing differs sharply.
rows.verification_step: Verify named tenant, corporate guaranty/master lease status, assignment release language, and franchisee store count.

rows.clause: Current Base Rent, Percentage Rent & Escalation Schedule
rows.why_critical: Determines current NOI, CPI vs. fixed bump protection against LA inflation (LA CPI-U +3.7% YoY Sep 2026), and mark-to-market spread.
rows.verification_step: Reconcile rent ledger against lease schedule, CPI caps/floors, and any historical COVID/deferral amendments.

rows.clause: Option Period Rent Reset Formula (Fixed Bump vs. Fair Market Value)
rows.why_critical: Below-market fixed option rents transfer value to the tenant; FMV resets introduce appraisal arbitration cost and rent uncertainty.
rows.verification_step: Check whether FMV has a floor ('not less than prior rent') and whether baseball arbitration applies.

rows.clause: NNN Expense Recovery & Landlord Capex Carve-Outs (Roof, Structure, Parking)
rows.why_critical: True Absolute NNN vs. NN (landlord roof/structure/slab/utility lines) changes cap rate, reserve deductions, and capital-expenditure exposure.
rows.verification_step: Verify who repairs/replaces roof, HVAC, parking lot, grease trap, ADA upgrades, and seismic retrofits.

rows.clause: Prop 13 Reassessment Pass-Through & Tax Appeal Cooperation
rows.why_critical: Buyers underwrite full Prop 13 market reassessment on sale; if the lease caps tax pass-throughs, buyer NOI drops and purchase price falls.
rows.verification_step: Confirm whether tenant pays 100% of reassessed real property taxes upon sale or has a Prop 13 protection cap.

rows.clause: Store Sales Reporting & Co-Tenancy / Go-Dark Rights
rows.why_critical: Store sales vs. rent (occupancy cost ratio) is the single strongest predictor of whether the tenant renews voluntarily or closes in JACK's store-optimization wave.
rows.verification_step: Check whether tenant must submit annual certified gross sales; inspect continuous-operation and recapture clauses.

rows.clause: Tenant ROFR / ROFO (Right of First Refusal / Offer)
rows.why_critical: A tenant ROFR chills third-party bidding and adds 15–45 days to closing timelines (critical when coordinating a 45-day §1031 identification clock).
rows.verification_step: Review purchase-option, ROFR, and ROFO provisions and notice timelines verbatim.

rows.clause: Casualty, Earthquake Insurance & Condemnation Termination Clauses
rows.why_critical: Determines whether tenant can terminate or abate rent after an earthquake, fire, or street widening—and who pays earthquake/FAIR Plan deductibles.
rows.verification_step: Cross-check lease insurance requirements against actual tenant COI and CDI commercial market limits.

rows.clause: Environmental Indemnity & Drive-Thru / Signage Use Restrictions
rows.why_critical: Governs historical UST/grease-trap liability, exclusivity clauses, and whether a grandfathered City of LA drive-thru entitlement survives vacancy (>1 year lapse risk).
rows.verification_step: Audit environmental indemnity + City of LA zoning/CUP conditions for drive-thru abandonment periods.

rows.clause: Existing Debt Maturity, Prepayment Penalty & Assumability
rows.why_critical: Defeasance or yield-maintenance penalties directly reduce net sale proceeds; low-rate assumable debt can widen the buyer pool when 10-Yr Treasury is 4.91%.
rows.verification_step: Pull promissory note, payoff quote, and maturity/prepayment schedule offline.

tax_rules_2026.impact: Applies to net gain above adjusted basis excluding unrecaptured §1250 depreciation. Updated from 2025 brackets.
Long-held commercial properties often carry heavy accumulated depreciation, taxing the first slice of gain at 25% rather than 20%.

tax_rules_2026.rule: Federal Net Investment Income Tax (NIIT, IRC §1411)
tax_rules_2026.impact: Stacks atop both LTCG (23.8% max) and §1250 recapture (28.8% max) for passive NNN landlords.

tax_rules_2026.rule: California Personal Income Tax (2026 Progressive Schedules — No LTCG Preference)
tax_rules_2026.impact: California taxes 100% of capital gains and §1250 recapture as ordinary income.

tax_rules_2026.rule: California Behavioral Health Services Tax (Formerly Mental Health Services Tax)
tax_rules_2026.rate_or_threshold: +1.00% on CA taxable income > $1,000,000 -> 13.30% top CA rate
tax_rules_2026.impact: Fixed $1,000,000 threshold (unindexed) pushes combined top Fed + CA marginal tax on gain to 37.1% (LTCG) / 42.1% (§1250) before transfer taxes.

tax_rules_2026.rule: City of Los Angeles Measure ULA (Effective July 1, 2026)
tax_rules_2026.impact: Applies to GROSS sale price (not gain) and creates massive dollar cliffs at $5,400,000 ($216k jump) and $10,900,000 ($599.5k total ULA). Applies inside City of LA only — even on a §1031 exchange!

tax_rules_2026.rule: City of LA Base Transfer Tax & LA County Documentary Transfer Tax
tax_rules_2026.impact: Unincorporated LA County pays ONLY 0.11% County DTT. Note: corrects legacy workspace/tax.html error ('city 0.055%' vs actual 0.45%).

tax_rules_2026.rule: IRC §1031 Like-Kind Exchange & CA FTB Form 3840 Out-of-State Clawback
tax_rules_2026.rate_or_threshold: 45-day identification / 180-day closing; annual CA Form 3840 reporting for out-of-state replacements
tax_rules_2026.impact: Defers Federal + CA income taxes (NOT Measure ULA or transfer taxes). Moving equity out of California does NOT erase deferred CA tax — FTB tracks it annually via Form 3840 until eventual taxable sale (or IRC §1014 basis step-up at death).

tax_rules_2026.rule: California Prop 13 & LA County Prop 8 Decline-in-Value Review
tax_rules_2026.rate_or_threshold: 1% base + voter bonds, max 2%/yr cap; Prop 8 RP-87 filing deadline 2026-11-30
tax_rules_2026.impact: Holding preserves low Prop 13 tax basis; selling triggers buyer reassessment to market value. Prop 8 allows temporary relief if current value < factored base.

tax_rules_2026.rule: Federal Estate Tax Exclusion & Step-Up in Basis (IRC §1014 / P.L. 119-21)
tax_rules_2026.rate_or_threshold: $15,000,000 federal estate/gift exclusion (per individual under P.L. 119-21)
tax_rules_2026.impact: For long-held, low-basis family assets, holding (or §1031-swapping into passive NNN until death) can permanently eliminate built-in capital gains & §1250 recapture via step-up in basis.

short_lease_quotes.notes: Blank until 3 dated Central LA QSR broker BOVs & lender quotes are logged. Typical institutional NNN lenders balk under 5 yrs WALT.
Key inflection bucket relative to 2030–2035 expiry window and 4.91% 10-Yr Treasury anchor.
Tests whether selling slightly earlier preserves a wider 1031 exchange buyer pool before the 5-year cliff.
Quantifies cap-rate compression upside if owner negotiates a 10–15 yr extension before marketing the asset.

short_lease_quotes.term_bucket: Vacant / Residual Land & Grandfathered Drive-Thru Value
short_lease_quotes.notes: Sets downside floor value if JACK does not renew (compares re-tenanting to rival QSR vs. infill multifamily land value).

regional_context.peril: Regional Seismicity (M >= 4.5 within 50 km of Central LA)
regional_context.detail: Queried directly from USGS FDSN Event API (34.0522, -118.2437). Site-specific spectral accelerations (ASCE 7-22 Ss/S1) require private coordinates.

regional_context.peril: Statutory Seismic Zones (Alquist-Priolo Fault / Liquefaction / Landslide)
regional_context.value: CGS EQ Zapp statutory zones active across LA Basin
regional_context.detail: Fault rupture & liquefaction zones trigger mandatory geotechnical/structural disclosures and dramatically raise PML & seismic retrofit costs.

regional_context.peril: LA County Federal Disaster Declarations (All Hazards)
regional_context.detail: Includes DR-4856-CA (Jan 2025 Eaton & Palisades Wildfires destroying 11,160 units), FM-5605 (Aug 2025 Canyon Fire), and 2023–24 atmospheric-river storm disasters (DR-4683, DR-4699, DR-4769).

regional_context.peril: Wildfire Hazard Severity Zones (CAL FIRE OSFM)
regional_context.value: 2025 LRA maps rolled out Feb–Mar 2025; 2026 SRA comment open Nov 9, 2026–Jan 8, 2027
regional_context.detail: Updated Local Responsibility Area (LRA) maps expand VHFHSZ/HFHSZ disclosures and affect commercial property underwriting even near urban-interface edges.

regional_context.peril: California Commercial Property & FAIR Plan Insurance Regime
regional_context.value: FAIR Plan commercial limit $20M/bldg ($100M/loc) eff. Jul 26, 2025; sunsets Dec 31, 2028
regional_context.detail: CDI Order 2026-2 & Sustainable Insurance Strategy (85% voluntary-market write rule) stabilize capacity, but FAIR Plan excludes earthquake, carries high deductibles/co-insurance, and faces a 2028 sunset.

parcel_screen.check: USGS ASCE 7-22 Site-Specific Spectral Values (Ss, S1, Site Class) & Seismic PML
parcel_screen.action: Run offline on parcel lat/lon + structural engineer seismic PML screening if building is pre-1994 or URM/non-ductile concrete.

parcel_screen.check: CGS EQ Zapp — Alquist-Priolo Fault, Liquefaction & Landslide Zone Status
parcel_screen.action: Query CGS EQ Zapp offline using parcel address/APN and save PDF map to private diligence folder.

parcel_screen.check: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer (NFHL / FIRM Panel & Flood Zone)
parcel_screen.action: Pull official FIRMette from FEMA Map Service Center (msc.fema.gov); confirm urban stormwater/drainage history.

parcel_screen.check: CAL FIRE 2025 LRA FHSZ Status & Smoke / Utility PSPS Exposure
parcel_screen.action: Check CAL FIRE LRA FHSZ viewer privately; verify tenant business-interruption / civil-authority coverage wording.

parcel_screen.check: Actual Commercial Property, Earthquake & Loss-of-Rent Insurance Quotes + Deductibles
parcel_screen.action: Verify tenant's current COI vs. lease obligations; quote standalone DIC/Earthquake (typical 5%–15% deductible) & carrier non-renewal exposure.

parcel_screen.check: Phase I Environmental (ESA) & Property Condition Assessment (PCA)
parcel_screen.action: Check historical gas-station/dry-cleaner adjacency, grease-trap integrity, roof remaining useful life, HVAC age, and ADA compliance.

compound_stress.trigger: 10-Yr Treasury stays >= 5.0% while WALT slips below 5 years without renewal
compound_stress.cash_flow_impact: Zero immediate rent loss, but buyer debt coverage shrinks and exit cap rate widens (+75 to +150 bps illustrative input in calculator).
compound_stress.mitigation: Test early blend-and-extend before WALT falls under 5 years; verify broker quotes (Gate G-08).

compound_stress.trigger: JACK or franchisee declines renewal amid negative SSS & store-closure program
compound_stress.cash_flow_impact: 6–18 months zero rent + owner absorbs taxes/insurance/security + $150k–$400k+ TI/LC/re-image capex (user-entered in calculator).
compound_stress.mitigation: Audit store sales early; preserve grandfathered drive-thru CUP; pre-market to competing QSR chains.

compound_stress.scenario: Black-Swan Compound Seismic Shock (Central LA M6.5+)
compound_stress.trigger: Major fault rupture / shaking damages building, utilities, and nearby corridors simultaneously
compound_stress.cash_flow_impact: Rent abatement/termination clause triggered + uninsured 5–15% earthquake deductible or full structural loss (FAIR Plan excludes EQ) + frozen transaction market.
compound_stress.mitigation: Verify lease casualty clause, confirm seismic PML & DIC earthquake coverage, avoid over-leverage.

compound_stress.scenario: Wildfire / Smoke / FAIR Plan Sunset & Insurance Shock
compound_stress.trigger: Regional conflagration triggers utility shutoffs/smoke closures + carrier retreat ahead of Dec 31, 2028 FAIR Plan commercial sunset
compound_stress.cash_flow_impact: Insurance premiums surge (straining franchisee NNN occupancy ratio) or lender declares insurance default.
compound_stress.mitigation: Verify tenant policy endorsements, wildfire defensible space, and lender insurance covenants before renewal.

risks.risk: Severe Combined Tax & Transfer-Tax Haircut (Capital Erosion)
risks.mechanism: Federal 20% LTCG + 25% §1250 + 3.8% NIIT + CA up to 13.30% + City of LA Measure ULA (4.0% >$5.4M / 5.5% >=$10.9M) + 0.56% base/county transfer tax can consume 30%–45%+ of gross equity.
risks.mitigation: Run exact 2026 numbers in hub/calculator.html; verify City vs. unincorporated County jurisdiction; price strategically near ULA cliffs ($5.4M / $10.9M).

risks.risk: Short-Lease Cap-Rate Discount & Shallow Lender Pool
risks.mechanism: With 10-Yr Treasury at 4.91% and JACK cutting store counts, selling unrenewed with <5 years remaining limits financed buyers and widens exit cap rate.
risks.mitigation: Obtain 3 dated broker BOVs across WALT buckets (Gate G-08) before listing; test whether negotiating a renewal first creates net price uplift exceeding rent concessions.

risks.risk: Loss of Lifetime Estate Step-Up in Basis (IRC §1014)
risks.mechanism: Realizing decades of low-basis gain shortly before an estate transfer permanently pays Federal + CA capital gains taxes that step-up at death would have eliminated.
risks.mitigation: Coordinate sale timing with estate counsel under the $15M federal exclusion (P.L. 119-21).

risks.risk: 45-Day Identification Compression & Overpaying for Replacement Asset
risks.mechanism: Strict statutory 45-day ID / 180-day closing clock can force the owner into a lower-quality or over-priced replacement NNN property; Measure ULA still hits the LA sale!
risks.mitigation: Pre-identify replacement markets, DST/TIC backups, and Qualified Intermediary before going under contract; clear any tenant ROFR first.

risks.risk: California FTB Form 3840 Out-of-State Tax Clawback
risks.mechanism: Exchanging into a zero-income-tax state does NOT forgive California deferred tax; FTB tracks deferred CA gain annually via Form 3840 and taxes it upon future taxable sale.
risks.mitigation: Plan a hold-until-step-up horizon on out-of-state replacement property or model eventual CA clawback explicitly.

risks.risk: Credit-Market Freeze or Buyer Default Mid-Exchange Window
risks.mechanism: A sudden rate spike (>134 bp 2026 YTD volatility) or banking shock can blow up replacement financing after Day 45, triggering unintended taxable boot.
risks.mitigation: Maintain backup all-cash or low-LTV replacement properties and institutional QI escrow protections.

risks.risk: Tenant Leverage & Rent Concession / TI Giveaway
risks.mechanism: Under AB 1228 ($20/hr wages), +3.7% LA CPI, and JACK's -15.4% franchise net rental spread compression, tenant may demand flat/reduced rent or remodel TI dollars to extend.
risks.mitigation: Demand trailing 3-year store sales before offering any rent concession; require corporate guaranty or stronger franchisee credit for any TI outlay.

risks.risk: Locking In Sub-Inflation Escalations or Uncapped Landlord Capex
risks.mechanism: Fixed 1%–1.5%/yr bumps lose real purchasing power if LA inflation persists near 3.7%, while aging roofs/HVAC/paving erode net cash flow.
risks.mitigation: Negotiate CPI-linked or 2.5%–3.0% bumps (or 10% every 5 yrs), absolute NNN maintenance shift, and full Prop 13 tax pass-through.

risks.risk: JACK Corporate Debt Refinancing / Restructuring Shock (May 2031 ARD)
risks.mechanism: JACK holds negative stockholders' equity (-$938M FY25), $500M 2026-1 Notes reaching May 2031 ARD, suspended dividends, and simultaneous CFO/CLO/CTO exits in Nov 2026. Distress could trigger lease rejection or renegotiation.
risks.mitigation: Monitor Q4/FY2026 10-K upon filing; verify underlying land/drive-thru residual value so recovery does not depend solely on JACK credit.

risks.risk: Dark-Store Vacancy, Re-Tenanting Capex & Entitlement Lapse

tracks.name: Track A — Diligence First, Hold Decision Open (Baseline Discipline)
tracks.focus: Complete Gates G-02 through G-08 (lease abstract, Prop 8 check before 2026-11-30, CPA basis, 3 broker BOVs, hazard screen) over 45–60 days before engaging the tenant or listing.
tracks.pros: Zero premature signaling to JACK; protects negotiating leverage; prevents irreversible tax/ULA mistakes.
tracks.cons: Takes 6–8 weeks during which 10-Yr Treasury (31 bp Nov swing) or JACK credit could move.

tracks.name: Track B — Blend-and-Extend First, Then Re-Evaluate Sale vs. Hold
tracks.focus: Use store sales & lease abstract to test whether tenant will sign a 10–15 yr renewal (with inflation-protected bumps and clean NNN) before deciding to hold or sell at a compressed cap rate.
tracks.pros: Eliminates short-lease valuation penalty if tenant accepts; expands financed buyer pool if sold later.
tracks.cons: Signals landlord engagement early; tenant may demand rent reduction or TI dollars amid AB 1228 margin pressure.

tracks.name: Track C — Pre-Cliff Marketing + §1031 Exchange Preparation
tracks.focus: If broker BOVs show severe cap-rate widening below 5 years WALT AND CPA confirms unacceptable taxable drag, prepare off-market/marketed sale paired with pre-vetted §1031 replacements (noting ULA & Form 3840 rules).
tracks.pros: Captures remaining WALT before cliff; diversifies out of single-asset LA seismic/operator concentration.
tracks.cons: Measure ULA still applies inside City of LA; 45-day ID pressure; CA Form 3840 clawback persists on out-of-state swaps.

tracks.name: Track D — Residual Land & Re-Tenanting Optionality Study
tracks.focus: If Central LA parcel sits in high-density TOC/transit corridor or carries a scarce grandfathered drive-thru, underwrite rival QSR replacement rent vs. infill multifamily land value.
tracks.pros: Establishes hard downside floor independent of JACK corporate turnaround.
tracks.cons: Requires zoning/architectural feasibility spend and multi-year patience if redeveloped.
